scope: B1 healthy common-G only, implementation lock before calibration or holdout
physical_seed: SeedSequence([*namespace, scenario_index, stage, batch_index]); stage 0 calibration, 1 holdout, 2 separate smoke only; stage 3 whole-path bootstrap
calibration: separate per scenario, strict score > order statistic ceil((n+1)*0.95) of path maxima over all seven directions and k>=4; first H1 score at k=5
monitoring: original six in frozen order, plus current target at bit 6; in each R scan the alternate complementary link remains fully accepted; reference q=1 retains all six other H1 gates
healthy_watermark: decoded healthy additive perturbation is identically zero for both labels, no watermark draws needed; independent physical samples and calibrations per label
scores: frozen single residual H1, independent of estimator weights; no H4/plugin-KL
statistics: follow B0, 84 path-paired comparisons per budget rule, report B and D families separately. No joint 95% claim across both families

bootstrap.unit: whole path candidate vector within scenario; independent resampling across the twelve scenarios
bootstrap.type: joint max of centered studentized lower deviations; report one-sided bounds and conditional empirical-distribution coverage diagnostic for primary t critical value, separately for B and D

safety: maximum spectral norm across every mask and receiver for each {1,q} table; strict <1
preflight: validate optimized scores against frozen ablation.scores_all and estimator against per-neighbor innovation on a separate smoke seed with target and simultaneous gate bits; frozen physical() for all splits
reporting: unconditional mean over health paths conditional on calibrated threshold. Exact binomial two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson per-scenario FWER. Report alarms per edge, run counts and lengths, bitmask frequencies, duration and co-occurrences. All mode descriptives, no mode-level tests.
